Overview

Vereeniging is a city in Gauteng with a population of 377,000. An industrial city on the Vaal River, part of the Vaal Triangle region known for steel and manufacturing. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
